note: Every field a loader reads admits exactly one type, and a value of any other type is refused and never coerced. `null` is not a value. An integer field refuses a boolean and a floating-point number. An action tier is exactly A, B or C. cooldown_seconds is from 0 to 86,400. A non-empty condition is at most 4,096 characters. Each case changes one member, named by `field`, of the manifest the accepted case `every_field_typed_accepted` carries.
refusal_note: `kind` is `type` for a value of the wrong type and `value` for a value of the right type outside what the field admits. `must_name` lists identifiers the refusal must contain: the field, and the trigger or action carrying it where that has a name. A type is checked before anything reads the member, so a container of the wrong type is refused for its type, not for what it then fails to hold.
value_note: Manifests are the parsed mapping. A string here is a quoted scalar in skill.yaml. 300.0 is written with a fraction so a JSON reader that keeps the integer and floating-point kinds apart yields a float.
scope_note: requires_approval is typed in tier-b-policy.json. Whether the rule engine can evaluate a condition is the runtime's grammar, which v3 does not state, so no case here tests it; the condition cases differ only in length.
